# `body_part`

A kind of body part: layers of material, what it supplies, where others attach (06 §6.1).

## Fields

Besides these, a definition takes the [keys every definition carries](README.md#keys-every-definition-carries).

- `name` ([text](../values.md#texts), or `null`; optional): What a reader calls it.
- `mass` ([mass](../units.md#mass) in `kg`; **required**): Its mass at scale 1.
- `length` ([length](../units.md#length) in `m`; **required**): How long it is at scale 1.
- `girth` ([length](../units.md#length) in `m`; **required**): How far across it is at scale 1. A cut whose span is at least this goes all the way through.
- `layers` (list of object [`LayerDef`](#layerdef); **required**): What it is built of, outermost first.
- `provides` (object, id of a [`body_function`](body_function.md) → number; optional): What it contributes to the body's functions, when in perfect condition (06 §6.3).
- `channels` (object, id of a [`channel`](channel.md) → whole number, 0 or more; optional): The channel slots it supplies while it works (03 §6.2).
- `sockets` (object, name → object [`SocketDef`](#socketdef); optional): Where other parts may attach, by socket name.
- `surfaces` (list of object [`SurfaceDef`](#surfacedef); optional): What it can strike with.
- `band` (list of 2: number, number, or `null`; optional): The share of the body's height it occupies, from the ground up: `[low, high]`, each from 0 to 1.
- `tags` (list of [tag](../values.md#tags); optional): Free-form tags.
- `exposure` (number; optional): How likely it is to be struck by an unaimed hit, relative to its size. Default 1.
- `disable_below` (number; optional): The condition below which it stops working. Default 0.5.
- `inside` (list of object [`InsideDef`](#insidedef); optional): Organs that come with it wherever it is used.
- `leaves` (one of `"item"`, `"nothing"` ([`Leaves`](#leaves)); optional): What it leaves when it is severed or destroyed.

<a id="layerdef"></a>
### `LayerDef`

One layer of a part, as its definition writes it (06 §6.1).

- `material` (id of a [`material`](material.md); **required**): What the layer is made of.
- `thickness` ([length](../units.md#length) in `m`; **required**): How thick it is, at scale 1.
- `weight` (number, or `null`; optional): How much the part's working depends on this layer, from 0 to 1. Layers that leave it out share what the others leave of 1, by thickness.

<a id="socketdef"></a>
### `SocketDef`

Where other parts may attach to a part (06 §6.1).

- `count` (whole number, 0 or more; optional): How many parts it takes.
- `accepts` (list of id of a [`body_part`](body_part.md); optional): The part definitions it takes. Empty for any.

<a id="surfacedef"></a>
### `SurfaceDef`

Something a part can strike with (06 §6.1; 07 §3.2). The body model carries it for combat and gives it no meaning.

- `id` (string; **required**): Its name among the part's surfaces.
- `kind` (id of a [`damage_type`](damage_type.md); **required**): The damage type it delivers.
- `area` (number; **required**): Contact area, in square metres.
- `give` ([length](../units.md#length) in `m`; **required**): The distance over which a strike with it is stopped.
- `span` ([length](../units.md#length) in `m`; optional): The length of contact across the target.

<a id="insidedef"></a>
### `InsideDef`

An organ that comes with a part wherever the part is used (06 §6.1, `inside`).

- `id` (string; **required**): Its name within the part: in a body it is `<part>.<id>`.
- `part` (id of a [`body_part`](body_part.md); **required**): What it is.

<a id="leaves"></a>
### `Leaves`

What a part leaves when it is severed or destroyed (06 §7.5).

One of:

- `"item"`: An item made of its materials.
- `"nothing"`: Nothing.
